title: Template -- Rundll32 loading a DLL from a user-writable path
author: WinstonRedGuard -- sigma plugin canonical templates
description: Canonical Sigma detection template for MITRE ATT&CK T1218.011 (System Binary Proxy Execution: Rundll32). Detects rundll32 loading a DLL from a common user-writable location, which is unusual for ordinary system DLL execution. The DLL entry-point delimiter narrows the signal to the normal rundll32 invocation shape. Synthetic exemplar from the WinstonRedGuard threat-intel corpus -- no actor binding; review and bind to your environment before deployment.
